summary: Encompass Health issued $500M of 5.875% Senior Notes due 2034 via a private Rule 144A/Reg S offering, netting ~$491.2M after discounts and expenses. Proceeds will redeem $400M of its 4.500% notes due 2028 at par and repay $100M under its revolver, representing a liability management / capital-return event through refinancing to lower near-term debt. The indenture with Computershare includes standard make-whole redemption provisions. No change in equity structure; watch ability to refinance remaining $400M of 2028 notes if callable. This is a debt capital return, not an equity distribution.
